key_decisions.rationale: Preserves ongoing salvation, condition, and empty-faith possibility.
key_decisions.before: through which also you are being saved, if you hold firmly to the word I proclaimed to you—unless you believed in vain.
key_decisions.after: Through it you are also being saved, if you hold firmly to the message I proclaimed to you—unless you believed for nothing.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: through which also you are being saved, if you hold fast to the word I proclaimed to you—unless you believed in vain.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves burial, enduring resurrection result, timing, and Scripture.
key_decisions.before: and that he was buried, and that he has been raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,
key_decisions.after: that he was buried, that he has been raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and that he was buried, and that he has been raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves number, contemporaneous witnesses, and death euphemism.
key_decisions.before: then he appeared to more than five hundred brothers and sisters at one time, most of whom remain until now, though some have fallen asleep;
key_decisions.after: Then he appeared to more than five hundred brothers and sisters at one time, most of whom remain alive until now, though some have fallen asleep in death.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: then he appeared to more than five hundred brothers at one time, most of whom remain until now, though some have fallen asleep;

key_decisions.rationale: Retains Paul's harsh birth image.
key_decisions.before: and last of all, as to one untimely born, he appeared also to me.
key_decisions.after: Last of all, as to one untimely born, he appeared also to me.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and last of all, as to one untimely born, he appeared also to me.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves grace/empty wordplay and labor qualification.
key_decisions.before: But by the grace of God I am what I am, and his grace toward me was not in vain; but I labored more abundantly than all of them—yet not I, but the grace of God with me.
key_decisions.after: But by God's grace I am what I am, and his grace toward me was not empty. Instead, I worked harder than all of them—yet not I, but God's grace with me.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But by the grace of God I am what I am, and his grace toward me was not in vain; but I labored more abundantly than all of them—yet not I, but the grace of God with me.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps limited-horizon consequence.
key_decisions.before: If in this life only we have hoped in Christ, we are of all people most to be pitied.
key_decisions.after: If we have placed our hope in Christ only for this life, we are more pitiful than all people.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: If in this life only we have hoped in Christ, we are of all people most to be pitied.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves triumphant turn and harvest image.
key_decisions.before: But now Christ has been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of people who have fallen asleep.
key_decisions.after: But now Christ has been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But now Christ has been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves both occurrences of all and corporate spheres.
key_decisions.before: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.
key_decisions.after: For just as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves transfer of kingdom and defeated powers.
key_decisions.before: then the end, when he hands over the kingdom to God the Father, when he abolishes all rule and all authority and power.
key_decisions.after: Then comes the end, when he hands over the kingdom to God the Father, after he brings to an end every ruler and every authority and power.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: then the end, when he hands over the kingdom to God the Father, when he abolishes all rule and all authority and power.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves repeated subjection and final purpose.
key_decisions.before: And when everything are subjected to him, then the Son himself also will be subjected to the one who subjected everything to him, so that God may be all in all.
key_decisions.after: And when all things are subjected to him, then the Son himself will also be subjected to the one who subjected all things to him, so that God may be all in all.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And when all things are subjected to him, then the Son himself also will be subjected to the one who subjected all things to him, so that God may be all in all.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps disputed practice without explaining or endorsing it.
key_decisions.before: Otherwise, what will those do who are baptized on behalf of the dead? If the dead are not raised at all, why then are they baptized on behalf of them?
key_decisions.after: Otherwise, what will those do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead are not raised at all, why are people baptized for them?
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Otherwise, what will those do who are baptized on behalf of the dead? If the dead are not raised at all, why then are they baptized on behalf of them?

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps daily death and emphatic oath.
key_decisions.before: I die daily—I affirm it, brothers and sisters, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord.
key_decisions.after: I die every day—I swear by my pride in you, brothers and sisters, which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I die daily—I affirm it, brothers, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves possible metaphor, geography, and quotation.
key_decisions.before: If according to man I fought with beasts at Ephesus, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, “Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”
key_decisions.after: If I fought wild beasts in Ephesus merely as a human, what did I gain? If the dead are not raised, “Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: If according to man I fought with beasts at Ephesus, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, “Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”

key_decisions.rationale: Retains insult and seed-death analogy.
key_decisions.before: Foolish one! What you sow does not come to life unless it dies.
key_decisions.after: Foolish person! What you sow does not come to life unless it dies.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Foolish one! What you sow does not come to life unless it dies.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps four embodied kinds.
key_decisions.before: Not all flesh is the same flesh, but one of humans, another flesh of animals, another of birds, and another of fish.
key_decisions.after: Not all flesh is the same: humans have one kind, land animals another, birds another, and fish another.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Not all flesh is the same flesh, but one of humans, another flesh of animals, another of birds, and another of fish.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves body in both states and explicit inference.
key_decisions.before: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual.
key_decisions.after: it is sown a natural body and raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual body.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps Adam contrast and Spirit title.
key_decisions.before: So also it is written, “The first man Adam became a living soul”; the last Adam became a life-giving spirit.
key_decisions.after: So it is written: “The first human, Adam, became a living being”; the last Adam became a life-giving Spirit.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: So also it is written, “The first man Adam became a living soul”; the last Adam became a life-giving spirit.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps origins and earthy material.
key_decisions.before: The first man is from the earth, earthy; the second man is from heaven.
key_decisions.after: The first human was from the earth, made of dust; the second human is from heaven.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: The first man is from the earth, earthy; the second man is from heaven.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows pinned future and image transformation.
key_decisions.before: And just as we have borne the image of the earthy, we will also bear the image of the heavenly.
key_decisions.after: And just as we have borne the image of the one made of dust, we will also bear the image of the heavenly one.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And just as we have borne the image of the earthy, we will also bear the image of the heavenly.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps inheritance incapacity and corruption contrast.
key_decisions.before: Now this I say, brothers and sisters, that flesh and blood are not able to inherit the kingdom of God, nor does corruption inherit incorruption.
key_decisions.after: Now I say this, brothers and sisters: flesh and blood cannot inherit God's kingdom, nor does the perishable inherit the imperishable.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Now this I say, brothers, that flesh and blood are not able to inherit the kingdom of God, nor does corruption inherit incorruption.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves pinned negation placement and universal change.
key_decisions.before: Look, I tell you a mystery: we will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,
key_decisions.after: Look, I tell you a mystery: we will not all fall asleep, but we will all be changed,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Behold, I tell you a mystery: we will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps fulfillment and swallowed-death image.
key_decisions.before: But when this corruptible puts on incorruption, and this mortal puts on immortality, then will come about the word that is written: “Death has been swallowed up in victory.
key_decisions.after: And when this perishable body puts on imperishability and this mortal body puts on immortality, then the written saying will come true: “Death has been swallowed up in victory.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But when this corruptible puts on incorruption, and this mortal puts on immortality, then will come about the word that is written: “Death has been swallowed up in victory.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves direct taunt and pinned repeated death.
key_decisions.before: O death, where is your victory? O death, where is your sting?”
key_decisions.after: “Where, death, is your victory? Where, death, is your sting?”
